links.comparator_used: CAD-only (DL-based pneumothorax detection without the electronic notification system), difference-in-differences
links.outcome: Time to treatment (TTT) for pneumothorax: supplemental oxygen, aspiration or tube thoracostomy, and thoracic surgery consultation
links.effect: Oxygen therapy: -143.8 min (95% CI -277.8 to -9.9; P = .035). Aspiration or tube thoracostomy: 14.4 min (95% CI -35.0 to 63.9). Thoracic and cardiovascular surgery consultation: 86.3 min (95% CI -175.1 to 347.6).
links.quote: There was a significant reduction in TTT for supplemental oxygen therapy for the CAD and ENS group compared with the CAD-only group in the postimplementation period (-143.8 min; 95% confidence interval [CI], -277.8 to -9.9; P = .035).

design_hint: simultaneous electronic notification alerting referring clinicians and radiologists
